front.title: Refusing DNS Queries That Have QTYPE=RRSIG

abstract.t: The Domain Name System (DNS) allows a query with QTYPE=RRSIG. Such a query has no useful answer. RRSIG resource records are meaningful only together with the resource records they cover, so a response can carry no more than an arbitrary subset of the signatures present at the query name. This document specifies that DNS responders refuse queries with QTYPE=RRSIG, and that DNS requestors do not send them. It supplies the guidance that [RFC8482] left unspecified.
